labels.title: Assistant
labels.thinking: The assistant is looking at the data…
labels.notConfigured: The assistant is not set up
labels.notConfiguredHint: To switch it on, an administrator needs to choose a provider and enter a key.
labels.noAccess: You do not have access to the assistant
labels.noAccessHint: Ask an administrator to give your role access to the assistant messages.
labels.moduleOff: The assistant module is switched off
labels.moduleOffHint: It is not part of your licence or is switched off in the settings.
labels.limitDay: Today's question limit is used up
labels.limitDayHint: It resets tomorrow. The figures are available in the reports.
labels.limitMonth: The assistant's monthly limit is used up
labels.limitMonthHint: An administrator can raise the limit in the settings.
labels.busy: The previous question is still being answered
labels.busyHint: Wait a few seconds and try again.
labels.errorHint: Nothing was changed. Try again, or open the report directly.
labels.draftNote: Nothing is saved yet — check the form and press Save.
labels.unsourcedHint: These figures are in no data result — check them.
labels.clearHistoryConfirm: Delete all your questions and answers from the journal? This cannot be undone.
labels.privacy: Your question and summarised data are sent to the AI provider. Private customers appear as K-n; phones and e-mails are masked. The assistant saves and changes nothing.
labels.aiNotice: AI can be wrong — check the important figures.
labels.tooLong: The question is too long (up to {n} characters).
labels.stopped_step_cap: The assistant stopped at its step limit.
labels.stopped_deadline: The assistant stopped at its time limit.
labels.stopped_budget: The question needed too much data — narrow it down.
labels.stopped_cut_off: The answer was cut off by length.
labels.stopped_provider_error: The provider was unavailable or rejected the request.
labels.q_Revenue: How much did we earn this week and how does it compare with last week?
labels.q_Order: Which supplies do we need to order?
labels.sInactive: Who has not come in a while
labels.q_Inactive: Which customers have not come in 60 days, and how many of them can we reach by e-mail?
labels.secretSet: A key is set — leave empty to keep it
labels.moduleOffAdmin: The “AI assistant” module is switched off in Settings → Modules.
labels.testHint: Sends one short request (a fraction of a cent) and shows the result.
labels.privacyHint: Never sent to the model: PINs, tokens, keys, full phones/e-mails. See docs/ASSISTANT.md.
labels.legalHint: Before switching on: a data-processing agreement with the provider and an entry in your processing register.

hints.assistantProvider: Off: the assistant does not work and nothing is sent.
hints.assistantApiKey: Write-only: kept on the server in data/config-internal.php and never shown again.
hints.assistantFallbackModel: A cheaper model tried once when the main one is overloaded (claude-haiku-5-5).
hints.assistantEffort: “Do not send” omits the parameter. Choose it if the provider rejects the parameter.
hints.assistantPiiLevel: Aggregates: private persons only as K-n. Names: the model may ask for a customer's name. Contacts: also a masked phone/e-mail. The role's rights always apply.
hints.assistantRetentionDays: At least 31 days (the limits are summed from the journal). Cleanup: bin/command assistant-purge and the daily job.
hints.assistantUsdToEur: The provider bills in USD; EUR is only a rough estimate.
